# Rocklin Ranch Veterinary Hospital

> Full-service veterinary hospital in Rocklin, CA with two locations offering urgent care, preventive wellness, surgery, diagnostics, and compassionate end-of-life services.

Rocklin Ranch Veterinary Hospital operates two convenient locations in Rocklin, California, providing comprehensive veterinary care from puppy and kitten wellness through senior pet management, emergency urgent care, and specialized surgical services. The hospital is AAHA-accredited and offers in-house diagnostics, pharmacy services, and flexible payment options including CareCredit and pet insurance.

## Key Topics

- Urgent Care & Emergency Services
- Preventive Care & Wellness Exams
- Pet Vaccinations & Parasite Prevention
- Puppy & Kitten Care
- Senior Pet Care
- Pet Dental Care
- Surgical Services
- Diagnostic Services
- Pet Nutrition
- In-House Pharmacy
- End-of-Life Care
- Two Rocklin Locations
- AAHA Accreditation
- CareCredit Financing
- Compassionate Care

## Urgent & Emergency Care

- [Urgent Pet Care in Rocklin | Rocklin Ranch Veterinary Hospital](https://www.rocklinranchvet.com/pet-emergency): Urgent care services offering same-day and walk-in pet emergency care 7 days a week.

## Core Veterinary Services

- [Services | Rocklin Ranch Veterinary Hospital – Rocklin, CA](https://www.rocklinranchvet.com/veterinary-services): Main services overview page covering wellness, dental, surgery, diagnostics, and emergency care.
- [Pet Wellness | Rocklin Ranch Veterinary Hospital – Rocklin, CA](https://www.rocklinranchvet.com/veterinary-services/pet-wellness.html): Pet wellness exams, preventive care, vaccinations, and health screening services.
- [Pet Vaccinations in Rocklin | Rocklin Ranch Veterinary Hospital](https://www.rocklinranchvet.com/veterinary-services/pet-vaccinations.html): Customized vaccination plans including core vaccines, deworming, and heartworm prevention.
- [Pet Dental | Rocklin Ranch Veterinary Hospital – Rocklin, CA](https://www.rocklinranchvet.com/veterinary-services/pet-dental-care.html): Dental care services including exams, cleanings, X-rays, and periodontal treatment.
- [Pet Surgery | Rocklin Ranch Veterinary Hospital – Rocklin, CA](https://www.rocklinranchvet.com/veterinary-services/veterinary-surgery.html): Surgical services including spay/neuter, soft tissue, orthopedic, and emergency procedures.
- [Pet Diagnostics | Rocklin Ranch Veterinary Hospital – Rocklin, CA](https://www.rocklinranchvet.com/veterinary-services/veterinary-diagnostics.html): In-house diagnostics with lab work, digital X-rays, and ultrasound imaging.

## Life Stage-Specific Care

- [Puppy & Kitten | Rocklin Ranch Veterinary Hospital – Rocklin, CA](https://www.rocklinranchvet.com/veterinary-services/puppy-kitten-care.html): Puppy and kitten care including exams, vaccines, nutrition, and behavioral guidance.
- [Senior Pets | Rocklin Ranch Veterinary Hospital – Rocklin, CA](https://www.rocklinranchvet.com/veterinary-services/senior-pet-care.html): Senior pet care with wellness exams, arthritis treatment, and pain management.

## Specialty Services & Support

- [Pet Nutrition | Rocklin Ranch Veterinary Hospital – Rocklin, CA](https://www.rocklinranchvet.com/veterinary-services/pet-nutrition.html): Expert nutrition advice and prescription diets for various health conditions.
- [Pharmacy | Rocklin Ranch Veterinary Hospital – Rocklin, CA](https://www.rocklinranchvet.com/veterinary-services/veterinary-pharmacy.html): In-house pharmacy offering prescriptions, parasite preventives, and specialty products.
- [End-of-Life | Rocklin Ranch Veterinary Hospital – Rocklin, CA](https://www.rocklinranchvet.com/veterinary-services/end-of-life-care.html): Compassionate end-of-life care and private euthanasia services.
